summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for comparative cache eviction algorithm selection (FIFO vs LRU) with specific workflow steps, constraints, and cautions. It does not semantically match existing skills (LLM alignment evaluation, Flink checkpoint tuning) which operate in different domains. Peer candidates (Adaptive Queue Size Balancing, Trace-Based Simulation Benchmarking, Parameter Tuning Risk Assessment) are complementary but separate capabilities at the same asset_level and granularity. The candidate's focus on algorithm selection via comparative experimentation is orthogonal to adaptive runtime tuning, benchmarking infrastructure, and risk assessment—each addresses different stages and methods. No existing skill covers this specific cache eviction selection workflow.
